items.title: Show HN: HN Match Maker – Matching "Who Wants to Be Hired?" With "Who's Hiring?"
items.summary: Hi! Every month the "Who Wants to Be Hired?" and "Who's Hiring?" Threads come through I would think to myself, "there should be a match maker for these two threads". So I had abacus.ai whip one up. The methodology is pretty simple, data is extracted from posts using an LLM, score matches based on salary, domain experience, remote/onsite, etc., and then eliminate incompatible postings, like 'looking for remote work' and 'onsite only'. The result is two views: jobs-by-user and user-by-jobs. If you've submitted a post to this month's 'Who Wants to Be Hired?", you can find your matching job listings at https://hnmatchmaker.com/user/:user_name , for example https://hnmatchmaker.com/user/G4Vi --- Some observations when looking at the matches pair up right now: Poke around, let me know what you think! Ultimately, I hope this is actually helpful to some folks. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49528057 Points: 5 # Comments: 1
